subject: Mathematics
topic: Numbers and operations / Vulgar and decimal fractions and percentages
title: Percentages and money
explanation: Per cent means "out of 100". So 15% is 15/100, which is 0.15.
To find a percentage of an amount, change the percentage to a decimal and multiply: 20% of N$ 450 is 0.2 × 450 = N$ 90.
To write one number as a percentage of another, divide and multiply by 100: 35 out of 50 is 35 ÷ 50 × 100 = 70%.
The multiplier method is the quickest way to increase or decrease. An increase of 15% means you now have 115%, so multiply by 1.15. A decrease of 15% leaves 85%, so multiply by 0.85.
Percentage increase or decrease = change ÷ original amount × 100. Always divide by the original amount, not the new one.

In Namibia VAT is 15%, so a price with VAT is the price before VAT × 1.15. To go backwards (reverse percentage), divide by the multiplier: a price of N$ 345 with VAT was 345 ÷ 1.15 = N$ 300 before VAT.
Simple interest is the same every year: I = P × R × T ÷ 100. Compound interest earns interest on the interest too: amount = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ after n years.
keyPoints: Increase by r%: multiply by (1 + r/100).
Decrease by r%: multiply by (1 − r/100).
Reverse percentage: divide by the multiplier.
Percentage change uses the original amount.

examples.q: The price of a school jersey rises from N$ 150 to N$ 180. Find the percentage increase.
A blanket costs N$ 345 including 15% VAT. Find the price before VAT.
steps: N$ 345 is 115% of the price before VAT.

practice.q: A learner scores 35 out of 50 in a test. What is this as a percentage?
practice.hint: Divide the score by the total, then multiply by 100.
An increase of 25% means multiplying by 1.25.
A decrease of 15% leaves 85%. Multiply by 0.85.

practice.q: Which number do you multiply by to decrease an amount by 12%?
practice.hint: After a decrease of 12%, what percentage is left?

practice.q: A pair of school shoes costs N$ 360 before VAT. VAT of 15% is added. What is the price with VAT, in N$?
practice.hint: With VAT the price is 115% of the price before VAT.

practice.q: The price of a bag of maize meal rises from N$ 250 to N$ 290. What is the percentage increase?
A second-hand bicycle loses value from N$ 1 200 to N$ 900. What is the percentage decrease?
practice.hint: Divide the decrease by the ORIGINAL value.

practice.q: After a 20% discount a radio costs N$ 560. What was the price before the discount, in N$?
practice.hint: N$ 560 is 80% of the original price. Divide by 0.8.

practice.q: A meal costs N$ 230 including 15% VAT. What was the price before VAT, in N$?
practice.hint: N$ 230 is 115% of the price before VAT. Divide by 1.15.

practice.q: Find the simple interest on N$ 2 000 at 6% per year for 3 years, in N$.
N$ 5 000 is saved at 8% per year compound interest. How much is in the account after 2 years, in N$?
practice.hint: Multiply by 1.08 once for each year.
